entities.summary: Tapfuma Gutsa (b. 1956, Harare) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Harare and Zimbabwe. Known in the fields of zimbabwe, painters & sculptors, africa.
